file_here: The file will arrive in this chat
working: You can close the chat — the bot will continue
delivered: The file has been sent to this chat
timeout: The bot did not respond. Please try again.
rate_limit: Please wait a moment and try again.
busy: Your previous request is still running.
unavailable: This action is unavailable. Send a new link.
expired_hint: This link has expired. Please send it again.
input_prompt: Send a link, or an artist and track name.
language_help: Choose a language: /language ru, /language en or /language auto.
start:
Send a link or a track/video name.
Choose audio or video after searching.
/bubbles — interactive cards
/plain — plain messages
/language — select language

expired: This card is no longer active. Send the link again.
empty: Add an artist or track name. You can also send a direct link.
source: The service did not provide the file. Try later or send another link.
send: The file was downloaded but could not be delivered to Telegram. Retry without downloading again.
uncertain: Telegram did not confirm delivery. Check the chat before trying again: another attempt may create a duplicate.
unavailable: YouTube reports that this recording is unavailable. Choose another result or send a different link.
search: The service did not respond in time. Please send the query again.

playlist: Playlists are not supported. Send a link to a single video.
prepare_failed: Could not prepare the file for sending.
source_failed: Download failed. Please try later or send another link.
sending_failed: The file could not be sent.
